subject.title: Discord plugin does not auto-reconnect after 1006 WS close (forces full gateway restart, kills in-flight turns)

question: Is the existing latest-release live evidence plus unchanged current-main Discord lifecycle source enough to sponsor a repair now, or should a maintainer first capture a current-main live trace that distinguishes scheduled reconnect, READY timeout, and health-monitor behavior?
rationale: The report is credible and high-impact, but the source inspection proves intended reconnect scheduling rather than the exact production failure point, and the issue is already marked for maintainer review with no new automatic fix PR.

options.title: Maintainer root-cause pass first
options.body: Keep this human-owned until a maintainer reviews or captures a current-main trace around close, reconnect scheduling, READY, and delivery state before authorizing a fix branch.

options.title: Queue bounded repair now
options.body: Allow a narrow Discord lifecycle repair attempt with focused tests, while still requiring live Discord proof before closing the issue.

options.title: Split fallback feature
options.body: Track channel-scoped reconnect as a separate operator recovery feature and keep this issue focused on automatic Discord WebSocket recovery.

recommendation.title: Maintainer root-cause pass first
recommendation.body: Keep this human-owned until a maintainer reviews or captures a current-main trace around close, reconnect scheduling, READY, and delivery state before authorizing a fix branch.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history across the Discord gateway readiness, supervision, and reconnect files that need the proof decision.
